blocks.title: Map in the right window
blocks.summary: The HUD's map replaces the stock one when the cluster's right window shows a map

blocks.text: The cluster behind the wheel shows one thing at a time: the instruments or any app on the car. A short press on the tile puts it there and takes it back.

footer.text: A short press on the tile does the same

blocks.text: When a turn signal is on, the camera on that side appears on the screen and goes away with the signal. “In the centre” shows both cameras, one above the other.
The chosen apps show on the passenger screen and the rear screen. Launch opens them there at once.

footer.text: A short press on the tile does the same

blocks.text: Raise

The speakers rise when music is playing or a player is open, including apps the car does not count as its own (Yandex Music, Spotify, YouTube, Kinopoisk, stock player). The car lowers them itself. “Raise” brings them up again if the car lowered them while idle.

Stock Shortcuts open apps on command: “Access map” and “Open video” start the ones chosen here. On this firmware music is started by “Continue playing” when nothing is playing; “Open music” always opens the stock player.
The language changes for the whole car, not for the app: the car itself opens the list, which has forty languages, and the chosen one applies at once, with no restart.

footer.text: A short press on the tile does the same

blocks.title: Keep Wi-Fi on
blocks.summary: The battery may drain faster while parked

blocks.text: The car reaches the cloud over Wi-Fi or mobile internet, and the Denza app on your phone works with it as usual: it shows the car's status and controls the car. The link comes back if the modem sees a Chinese ICCID, from the original eSIM or from an rSIM. “Keep Wi-Fi on” stops the car turning Wi-Fi off when it goes to sleep, so the link stays while parked.
